Group workspace/group submission status

Stay in workspacePrepare shared attempt
Permissions
  • Workspace requires current eligible membership. Historical receipt access follows snapshotted recipients and institution policy.
  • One submission for group never exposes another learner's individual override.
  • Group grading basis comes from published W40/W52; members cannot change it or release results.
Responsive
  • Member list and assignment/status panels stack.
  • Version-conflict notice appears before preparation actions and remains readable at zoom.
Accessibility
  • Shared versus personal result headings explicitly name their audience.
  • Updates announce status without moving focus; member lists are semantic lists.
Data
  • Group/set/membership version and current authorized work references.
  • Shared draft version, immutable receipt/member snapshot and own release reference.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Concurrent member submissions resolve one accepted operation or explicit conflict, never overwrite a receipt.
  • Membership change forces refreshed review and cannot rewrite a prior receipt.
  • A private individual grade override appears only in that learner's W23/W24.
  • Offline group status is labelled last known and cannot claim another member's latest action.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template; legacy IDs are lineage only.
  • New group workflow; live collaborative editing/chat is outside scope.
